Located at 350 Cottage Rd, this location offers advanced, non-surgical treatments helping men and women achieve radiant, youthful skin. We treat every client individually, everyone’s skin is different. Using leading-edge technologies and the latest in skincare science, our providers create unique treatment combinations tailored to your specific concerns and goals. Exterior Interior Services at So. Portland Virtue RF Microneedling Radiofrequency microneedling for skin tightening, texture improvement, and collagen stimulation. Enjoy filter-free, makeup-free results. Dermalinfusion Simultaneous exfoliation, extraction, and serum infusion optimizing plumpness, volume, hydration, tone, and texture. Chemical Peels Medical-grade peels to exfoliate and brighten skin, reduce fine lines, uneven pigmentation, and mild acne. SkinPen Microneedling FDA-cleared microneedling to stimulate collagen production for smoother, firmer, more youthful-looking skin. Ultherapy® Prime Non-invasive ultrasound skin tightening and lifting for face, neck, and décolletage. FDA-cleared with no downtime. truSculpt 3D Non-invasive body contouring using radiofrequency to tone muscles and reduce stubborn fat. Laser Hair Removal Permanent hair reduction for all body areas using advanced laser technology safe for all skin types. Laser Genesis Non-invasive laser treatment to promote collagen regrowth, reduce redness, minimize pores, and improve skin texture. Wrinkle Relaxers & Fillers Botox, dermal fillers, and lip augmentation for natural-looking facial rejuvenation and volume restoration. IPL Photo-Rejuvenation Intense Pulsed Light treatments to correct uneven pigmentation, sun damage, and vascular lesions. Bridal Packages Customized wedding skin and body treatments to help you look radiant for your big day. From facials to injectables. Virtual Wellness HRT, weight loss, peptide therapy, thyroid management, and comprehensive lab reviews via virtual consultation. Alastin Skincare Support healthier, more radiant skin with physician recommended Alastin skincare.
